metadata.name: Isaac CRT
metadata.description:
Isaac CRT brings CRT phosphors, LCD cells and VHS texture to The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+.
[b]Subscribing does NOT install the native graphics DLL. Manual installation is required.[/b] This Workshop companion adds an Isaac CRT entry to the Mods menu. Install the graphics mod separately using the [url=https://github.com/vici1129/isaac-crt/blob/main/INSTALL.txt]installation guide[/url].
[h2]Five treatments, two keys[/h2] Choose CRT Core, CRT Studio, LCD Light, LCD Strong or VHS.
[b]F7:[/b] Cycle through the five treatments and Off. [b]F6:[/b] Toggle Flat/Curved for CRT Core, CRT Studio and VHS, or Ghosting On/Off for LCD Light and LCD Strong. Your selections are saved automatically.
Effects add GPU overhead; simpler or flat treatments may run better on slower hardware.
[h2]Download and installation[/h2] Version 0.1.0 is being prepared; no GitHub Release is available yet. Packages will be available on [url=https://github.com/vici1129/isaac-crt/releases]GitHub Releases[/url]. Follow the installation guide for Windows, Linux/Steam Deck and REPENTOGON.
Use F7 to select Off. To uninstall, close Isaac and remove the opengl32.dll you installed. Unsubscribing from this companion leaves the native DLL installed.
Browse [url=https://github.com/vici1129/isaac-crt/tree/main/screenshots]screenshots[/url]. An unofficial project, not affiliated with or endorsed by the game's creators.
